Understanding Your Brand's Technology

The platforms you will run the business on, and what they cost.

How Technology Sourcing Works

PH-04 sourcing entity sources our software platforms and negotiates vendor pricing using the scale of the full portfolio. They hold vendors accountable and provide support when something breaks.

Every brand's package is different. There is a one-time setup fee plus a monthly payment. PH-04 sourcing entity collects from you and pays the vendors.
